notes: V0.3.1 failed because raw price-core accuracy did not beat a naive always-UP benchmark and balanced accuracy was near random.
V0.3.2 reduced class-prior bias but still failed balanced-accuracy, down-recall, and confidence-calibration gates.
V0.3.3 removes class-frequency advantage at the analog-comparison stage: UP30_FIRST and DN20_FIRST compete with exactly the same number of independent episode representatives.
One historical episode may represent only one side globally, chosen by its most-similar eligible anchor, so one regime cannot populate both fractal and counter-fractal lists.
The class score is predeclared as 50% mean similarity + 30% median similarity + 20% best-match similarity across top-5 episodes per class.
Direction requires a minimum class-score gap, paired-rank majority, and mean/median/top1 metric majority; otherwise the engine ABSTAINS.
Validation remains one predeclared walk-forward anchor per independent point-in-time test episode and must report balanced accuracy plus both class recalls.
Current V0.3.3 work is price-core only. On-chain/macro confirmation is retested only after the class-balanced core passes; derivatives/ETF layers stay blocked.
No future data may be used in feature construction, episode assignment, candidate outcomes, or validation labels.
N/A is excluded and weights are renormalized; N/A is never zero-filled.
MVRVZ_DERIVED_PIT is a point-in-time derived proxy, not a vendor-reported official MVRV Z-Score.
MASTER BTC TREND scoring, entry gates, schedule, and live plan remain untouched.
